items.title: Is Cboe (CBOE) Using Its Expanded Credit Facility To Quietly Reposition Its Clearing Strategy?

The updated facility not only refreshes legal terms but also adds flexibility in covenants and permissions to better support Cboe’s clearing activities and potential subsidiary...
